checkpoint: SiT-XL/2 ImageNet 256, 1.3M steps, guidance 4x4 (paper Table 2 setting), results/showcase/imagenet_rel_cfg_clean/step1300000/{A,E}/combo_4x4
selection: 20 of the 100 test prompts of the paper (Table 2). Kept prompts where OWLv2 detects both objects in all four images (both models, original and flipped relation), then a blind visual check (four images shuffled per prompt, models hidden) for clearly recognizable, non-overlapping objects; dropped worn items (shorts/t-shirt, collars, glasses on jackets, tassels), overlapping pairs (dog on bench, sign on fence, lettuce in a burger), and hard-to-recognize objects (strainer, garlic, soap, fire screen, colander without microwave). This conditions on both objects appearing. On these 20 prompts the automatic detector gives per-image accuracy 0.47 (Self-Flow) vs 0.88 (SSF) and both-correct 0/20 vs 15/20, compared to 0.32 vs 0.55 and 2% vs 32% on all 100 prompts.
